source: ESPN public injury report and game summaries

injuries.name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
injuries.short_comment: Antetokounmpo is probable for Friday's game against the Knicks due to right groin tendinitis.
injuries.long_comment: The fact that Antetokounmpo is probable suggests the star forward should have a decent chance to suit up Friday. He's been playing at a high level lately, recording four consecutive double-doubles and averaging 28.6 points, 12.9 rebounds, 5.3 assists and 1.6 blocks per game since the beginning of November.

injuries.name: Andrew Wiggins
injuries.short_comment: Wiggins is probable for Friday's game against the Knicks due to a right ankle sprain.
injuries.long_comment: Wiggins has been added to the injury report and could miss a game for the first time this season. The veteran forward hasn't started a game since Nov. 5 and is averaging just 9.8 points per game when deployed with the second unit. His fantasy appeal won't be very high if he stays in this bench role.

injuries.name: Jordan Clarkson
injuries.short_comment: Clarkson (foot) is questionable for Friday's game against the Heat.
injuries.long_comment: Seeing Clarkson as questionable instead of being out one day in advance of the game is a step in the right direction. However, don't expect the veteran guard to play a big role off the bench if he's cleared to suit up. He's averaging just 9.8 minutes per game in 12 outings off the bench this season.

injuries.name: OG Anunoby
injuries.short_comment: Anunoby (calf) is doubtful for Friday's game against the Heat.
injuries.long_comment: Anunoby started doing on-court work Wednesday, but all signs point toward this game coming a bit too soon for the veteran forward. Anunoby has missed the Knicks' past two games due to left calf soreness, and if he's out, Landry Shamet could remain in the starting unit.

injuries.name: Miles McBride
injuries.short_comment: McBride (groin) is questionable for Friday's game against the Heat.
injuries.long_comment: McBride has missed the Knicks' previous two games. Even if he's cleared to return Friday, he wouldn't carry a ton of fantasy appeal. He's averaging just 6.8 points per game this season.

injuries.name: Andre Drummond
injuries.short_comment: Drummond (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Heat.
injuries.long_comment: Drummond played just nine minutes prior to exiting Wednesday's 121-102 win over Cleveland due to a concussion. Mohamed Diawara and James Wiseman will likely get a boost in playing time off the Knicks' bench with Drummond sidelined. His next chance to suit up will come against the Hawks on Sunday.
